Independent Franchise Partners Llp Position in Twenty First Centy Fox INC (FOXA) Has Raised by $132.53 Million as Share Value Rose Posted by Hazel Jackson 36 pm
Independent Franchise Partners Llp increased its stake in Twenty First Centy Fox Inc (FOXA) by 11.05% based on its latest 2018Q3 regulatory filing with the SEC. Independent Franchise Partners Llp bought 2.88M shares as the company’s stock rose 9.84% while stock markets declined. The institutional investor held 28.96 million shares of the consumer services company at the end of 2018Q3, valued at $1.34 billion, up from 26.08 million at the end of the previous reported quarter. Independent Franchise Partners Llp who had been investing in Twenty First Centy Fox Inc for a number of months, seems to be bullish on the $88.90B market cap company. The stock increased 1.22% or $0.58 during the last trading session, reaching $48.06. About 10.49M shares traded. Twenty-First Century Fox, Inc. (NASDAQ:FOXA) has risen 44.38% uptrending. It has outperformed by 44.38% the S&P500.
Independent Franchise Partners Llp, which manages about $13.30 billion and $10.41 billion US Long portfolio, decreased its stake in S&P Global Inc by 431,468 shares to 2.64M shares, valued at $516.47M in 2018Q3, according to the filing. It also reduced its holding in Chipotle Mexican Grill Inc (NYSE:CMG) by 16,673 shares in the quarter, leaving it with 1.30 million shares, and cut its stake in Apple Inc (NASDAQ:AAPL).
